context: A business plans to sell an existing product to customers in a country where it has not previously operated.
stem: Select the Ansoff growth direction described.

option_rationale: A is incorrect because market penetration uses existing products in existing markets.
B is correct because the product is existing and the market is new to the business.
C is incorrect because product development introduces a new product to an existing market.
D is incorrect because diversification involves both a new product and a new market.
